description: Put what is ready into each account's free posting times for the next days (default 7): approved posts with no time first, then drafts with no errors. A dry run also lists suggested: evergreen posts due to come back in that time and where each copy would land (the evergreen worker makes them as drafts; this call never does). A draft is approved by this, so drafts are left out unless the caller may publish (skipped.needs_publish counts them). A connection approves only at the post level, only posts it wrote, never TikTok or YouTube, within its hourly limit; otherwise the drafts wait for a person and note says so. TikTok drafts that need their audience picked, posts with errors and Reels paired with a Trial Reel stay for a person (skipped.needs_review). Never two posts in one account's slot; slots follow the account's posting times, quiet days and daily cap. dry_run=true returns the placements and changes nothing. A real run returns activity_id; undo restores every post's state and time.

days.description: How far ahead slots may fall

dry_run.description: Return the placements without scheduling anything

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

post_ids.description: Only these posts; left out: everything ready

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
